patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "softbank group", 2026-10-03

profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a public company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Its website describes it as presenting its philosophy, vision, and strategy, along with corporate information, shareholder and investor relations information, business segments and group companies, and sustainability (ESG) information. The site names Masayoshi Son as Representative Director, Chairman and CEO, and gives the English name SoftBank Group Corp. The site also states that it introduces the company's thinking in the era of the AI revolution, the efforts of group companies, and the possibilities that AI brings.

The company trades under the ticker SFTBF and has CIK 0001065521. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
